title: Avoid unmortgaging when cash-poor
description: Avoid unmortgaging when cash-poor. Unmortgaging is legal but wrong with only a thin rent cushion. Optional-action restraint matters here because legal tools are not automatically useful tools.

final_action.public_message: Beta, would you trade me $150 for my Reading Railroad? It could help both of us.
final_action.private_thought: I need cash to avoid bankruptcy and to be flexible for future trades. Offering Reading Railroad for $150 to Beta gives me enough liquidity. Beta has plenty of cash and may accept.
